name: EKODI Core
purpose: Keep EKODI-owned identity, organization, authorization, audit and service contracts independent from replaceable infrastructure providers.

architectureAlignment.osRelationship: EKODI OS coordinates platform-wide execution; EKODI Core provides stable shared contracts, authority and controls.
architectureAlignment.rule: Core is not the container for every business capability. Responsible Independent Services keep explicit domain contracts even when they share a modular-monolith deployment.

dataStrategy.authoritativeRule: Each domain owns its data. Cross-platform access uses an explicit shared API contract.

stores.role: shared control-plane and selected service namespaces
platform-owned relational workloads and auth where declared
documents, media, exports and independent backup artifacts

rules: Do not consolidate healthy platform data into one database only for architectural symmetry.
Prefer portable schemas and exportable formats.
A shared database migration is a shared-core change.
Tenant-private data must not be read or written across boundaries without explicit authorization.
Core business functions must remain usable when every external AI provider is unavailable.
Browser clients must not depend on direct provider credentials.
AI providers are replaceable adapters, not system-of-record dependencies.
Privileged AI actions remain governed, observable and reversible where feasible.

providerIndependence.principle: Cloud providers are infrastructure. EKODI Core is the product boundary.
